steps.text: If the player never spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.npc: Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.

steps.text: If the player spoke to Ramarno after completion of Below Ice Mountain:

steps.npc: Hello. Sorry, I'd love to stop and chat, but I have a new find that I need to work on. If you need anything, I'm sure Prescott can help.
